output.gold_handling: answer is null and metadata.gold is scorer-only; supporting annotations and decompositions are absent from question/documents.

musique.public_document_format: title + newline + original paragraph_text when title is supplied

finqa.answer_typing: decimal/scientific notation and percent values -> number; yes/no/true/false -> boolean; other values -> string
finqa.annotation_status: exploratory prior-exposed; raw exe_ans preserved and known annotation limitations are recorded per case

v2_changes.boolq: metadata.source_row_index is the validation parquet row before shuffle
v2_changes.ag_news: metadata.source_row_index is the list of test parquet row indices before shuffle for each disjoint group
v2_changes.longbench_v2: unchanged from v1: official HF snapshot zai-org/LongBench-v2 revision 2b48e494f2c7a2f0af81aae178e05c7e1dde0fe9, Apache-2.0, no context truncation

limitations: Exploratory breadth screen only; MuSiQue and FinQA are prior-exposed, not unexposed confirmatory evaluation.
LongBench v2 original contexts are intentionally untruncated; the runner owns any tokenizer cap.
AG News has 238, not 512, disjoint mixed-size groups because 7,600 source articles constrain 8/24/64 groups.
FinQA number gold is preserved as a string; this selected slice has no percent/comma strings but has one scientific-notation string, so a float-only scorer needs explicit normalization.
